reason: I work full time and only get Saturdays, and our go-to is the free Salisbury Zoo. Paying $49-59 a month for a once-a-week outing doesn't add up, and it sounds like CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor.
objection: I'd only use it about four Saturdays a month, so the unlimited membership doesn't pay off. $12 a visit is more than the free zoo and I can't tell why it beats CoCo's.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper weekend-only or punch-card pass (around $30 a month or $8 a visit), or a free trial Saturday that shows it's clearly different from CoCo's.
